info.title: User Agent Parser (browser, OS, device, bot)
info.description: Parse any User-Agent string into browser and version, operating system and version, device type (mobile/tablet/desktop), rendering engine and bot detection.

parameters.name: ua
parameters.example: Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 17_0 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 Version/17.0 Mobile/15E148 Safari/604.1
